title: What If You Could Ride an Elevator to Space?

scenes.text: What if you could ride an elevator into space? The trip would take days.
A space elevator would run to geostationary orbit, about 35,786 kilometers up. At bullet-train speed, that's roughly five days.
The cable would have to stretch the whole way. No material we can make today is strong enough.
Carbon nanotubes might do it on paper, but nobody has made perfect strands anywhere near that long.
At the top, you'd be weightless, because you'd circle Earth in step with the ground below.
And launches would get far cheaper. Climbing beats burning a rocket, if we ever solve the cable.
